//: Used in: app/(onboarding)/consent/index.tsx (consent namespace). Marketing opt-in (email + push), shown to EVERY locale. The body MUST name both channels (email + push notifications): Apple 4.5.4 and GDPR informed consent require the channels in the visible consent language, not just this comment. Keep DISTINCT from the notifications permission step users hit right before this: frame this as optional promotions so it doesn't read as a repeat.
heading: Deals & new places
body: We'll send you the best local offers and reminders by email and push notifications. Turn it off anytime.
